Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and mild proteinuria are present. Glucosuria is noted without ketonuria, which may warrant further evaluation for glycemic control. Low specific gravity suggests dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
